items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: I played with Sam Morgan before he died.

ctx.x: I played with Sam Morgan before he died. Played with all of them brothers. I was still there though. Were you steady with Chris?

Huh? Were you steady man with Chris? With Chris, no. What about Buddy Petit? Played with him too. Yeah, I played with all of them brothers, man. My brothers couldn't get nobody, they'd come get me, see? They were scared to ask me, you know, if I wouldn't play, you know?
